# Architecture Flows

Runtime flows through the system. Prefer Mermaid so agents can reason about
direction. See `ai-context/diagrams/` for diagram sources.

## Primary flow

```mermaid
flowchart TD
  Client[HTTP client] --> Server[src/server.js node:http server]
  Server --> Router[src/router.js route(req, res)]
  Router --> Store[src/store.js task Map]
  Store --> Router
  Router --> Client
```

## Request handling

1. `src/server.js` creates a Node HTTP server and listens on `PORT` or `3000`.
2. Each request is passed to `route(req, res)` in `src/router.js`.
3. `src/router.js` matches `/health` or `/tasks` routes.
4. Task routes call the in-memory operations exported by `src/store.js`.
5. Responses are serialized as JSON when a payload exists; successful deletes
   return `204` with no body.
6. If `route` rejects, `src/server.js` returns
   `500 { "error": "internal server error" }`.

No outbound external integration is part of the verified runtime flow.
